Forage is hiring a New Grad Software Engineer to join its Engineering department. The role involves building user-friendly, reliable, scalable features across backend or frontend teams, participating in the full development lifecycle, and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and operations teams. The engineer will also develop project management and technical leadership skills while helping expand access to food.

Join small, focused teams, ship impactful features, and empower others through code

Give and receive thoughtful feedback in code reviews
Contribute to technical designs
Ensure the systems your team operates are reliable, scalable, and user-friendly
Be involved in the entire development lifecycle, from implementation to launch
If you join the backend team, you'll primarily work with Python and frameworks like Django
On the frontend team, you'll work with TypeScript and contribute to our Android or iOS SDKs
Collaborate on cross-functional projects with engineers, product managers, and operations teams to ship impactful features
Develop skills in project management and technical leadership
Gain the confidence to take ownership of projects from start to finish
Empower more Americans to access food
